_purpose: Room 4D — Project 001, D-001B Phase 1. Every extracted question needs at least one round of authoritative verification before verifiedAnswer/verificationStatus can be trusted for scoring; this queue tracks that work and its priority. No authoritative web verification was performed as part of D-001B (out of scope) — priorities are assigned purely from the risk signals visible in the source (regulatory sensitivity, conflicting/duplicate questions).

priorityLegend.P0: Conflicting, potentially dangerous, or potentially outdated — review first.
priorityLegend.P1: Regulatory/time-sensitive (law, tax, licensing, Social Security rules that change over time).
priorityLegend.P2: Ordinary answer verification — source-marked answer likely correct but not yet independently confirmed.
priorityLegend.P3: Editorial cleanup only (e.g. illegible/uncertain source text). None of this batch required P3.
